note: Illinois DNR recreation area near Pinckneyville on reclaimed strip-mine land with dozens of small lakes. Three primitive camping areas (Boulder Lake and Heron among them) and a separate small equestrian camp; campers get a permit from site staff. Water and the dump station are by the site office, not in the camping areas. --Claude
